verdict: Leads are arriving at a strong cost, but none are moving through intake.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 179 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.82 per lead — a healthy efficiency figure. However, none of those leads have converted into active opportunities in your CRM, meaning contacts are coming in and stalling before anyone works them. This is an intake process gap, not an ads problem. SMS automation and follow-up workflows are being activated to close that gap and ensure leads are reached quickly. We also need three overdue items — a contract extension, SMS automation, and system access — resolved on your end this week to unlock the next phase of the program.
